description: Get a user's Aave V4 transaction history. Defaults to every ActivityType, including BORROW_SWAP, supply/withdraw swaps, repay-with-supply, leverage, liquidations, and collateral toggles. Pass `types` to narrow. Defaults to Ethereum + Base. No API key needed.

chainId.description: Optional chain filter (1=Ethereum, 8453=Base). Omit to query Ethereum + Base (includes the Coinbase Stocks hub).

types.description: Activity types to include. Omit for all types (SUPPLY, BORROW, REPAY, WITHDRAW, LIQUIDATED, SET_AS_COLLATERAL, UPDATED_DYNAMIC_CONFIG, UPDATED_RISK_PREMIUM, TOKEN_TO_TOKEN_SWAP, SUPPLY_SWAP, BORROW_SWAP, REPAY_WITH_SUPPLY, WITHDRAW_SWAP, LEVERAGE).

name: get_v4_user_activities
